headline:
The 30-Year Rate
Edged Down To 7.32%
titan_line: Echo, Freddie Mac says the 30-year fixed rate averaged 7.32% as of October 22, down from 7.40% the week before. A year ago it was 6.19%. The 15-year averaged 6.68%.
checks_rows: A national average from loan applications, not a quote
echo_line: Lower than last week? …Oh, but higher than last year. I'd still ask a lender for my own number.
source: Freddie Mac Primary Mortgage Market Survey · week of October 22, 2026 · read October 23, 2026
disclaimer: National weekly averages for the week stated. Not a rate quote or a prediction. Your own rate depends on your lender and your credit.
